description: Show a card with stats for a single GitHub repository

pat.description: Reuses the same token configured for the GitHub plugin, if you already have one.
pat.label: GitHub Classic Token

banner_height.label: Extra height
banner_height.tooltip: Extra space (px) added at the bottom of the banner, on top of its normal size.

banner_image.description: Optional image URL (project logo etc.) shown instead of the repository mark
banner_image.label: Custom image (URL)
banner_image.tooltip: Converted to base64 at generation time so it works inside Gists. Leave empty to use the owner avatar.

banner_show_avatar.label: Show avatar
banner_show_avatar.tooltip: Shows the owner avatar / repository mark (Hero, Minimal and Dark styles).

banner_show_languages.label: Show primary language
banner_show_languages.tooltip: Shows the primary language dot in the meta row (Hero and Display styles).

banner_show_owner.label: Show owner
banner_show_owner.tooltip: Shows the owner login (e.g. "weebprofile /") before the repository name.
